overview.categories.title: Planned vs spent
overview.hero.future: This plan starts on {date}. Safe to spend and pace appear once it runs.
overview.hero.noPlan: This plan has no planned expenses, so there is no daily amount to show.
overview.hero.overExplanation: Spending is past the plan by {amount}, so nothing is left to spend a day until {date}.
overview.hero.spread: Spread over the {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} to {date}, that is {amount} a day. The light in the lens is what is still in the plan; it dims and shrinks as you spend.
overview.hero.title: Safe to spend today
overview.pace.aria.over: Pace: {left} of the plan is still left as light, {month} of the month is still to come. The light stops before the mark, so spending is over pace.
overview.pace.aria.under: Pace: {left} of the plan is still left as light, {month} of the month is still to come. The light reaches past the mark, so spending is under pace.
overview.pace.summaryOver: Spending is {points, plural, one {# point} other {# points}} ahead of the calendar. At this pace {plan} closes about {amount} over plan.
overview.pace.summaryOverStillUnder: Spending is {points, plural, one {# point} other {# points}} ahead of the calendar. At this pace {plan} still closes about {amount} under plan.
overview.pace.summaryUnder: Spending is {points, plural, one {# point} other {# points}} behind the calendar. Keep it near {perDay} a day and {plan} closes about {amount} under plan.
